instruction: Change the page orientation of this document to landscape.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported the docx document to PDF using File > Export as PDF menu in LibreOffice Writer, keeping the original filename. Completed in 13 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with LibreOffice Writer menus, navigate File menu options, use Export as PDF dialog, handle file save dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed model can operate Writer menus. This variation tests page layout modification via Format > Page Style, a harder document formatting task.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing page orientation to landscape via Format > Page Style > Page tab. Getter reads the docx and compares page width vs height for all sections. Metric checks if all sections have width > height (landscape). Partial credit if some sections are landscape.

scoring_breakdown.partial_landscape: 0.5 - Some but not all sections in landscape

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly determines landscape orientation by comparing page_width > page_height for all document sections, which is the standard method
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('all_landscape')) — properly handles type='rule' where expected IS the rules dict
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (change to landscape) is completely verified
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S + Enter for format dialog) before getter reads the file, ensuring fresh state
Partial credit logic is sensible: 0.5 if some but not all sections are landscape, 1.0 if all sections are landscape
Error handling is adequate: getter returns error dict on missing file, metric returns 0.0 on error
